title: GLM 5.3 Flash is now available in Token Pass
summary_en: Token Pass now includes GLM 5.3 Flash , alongside Kimi K3, GLM 5.3, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (with more models to come). GLM 5.3 Flash is Z.ai's native multimodal coding model with a 1M-token context window. Token Pass is a $30/month subscription on Pro teams that grants $80 in monthly credit and runs through AI Gateway . Use it with any coding agent such as fx , Pi , Cline , Command Code etc. or build your own with the AI SDK, with Zero Data Retention enabled by default.
